name: agent-builder-git-grant-reconciled
body: The `agent-builder` reads git through the genuinely read-only grants `git status *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git remote -v`, `git remote show *`, and `git ls-files *`. Its git mutation is `git add *` and `git commit *`. Push and tag operations belong to the optional `release-agent` as an ask. `--output=<file>` is forbidden on every granted git verb: `git log *` admits the output-redirect form, so the agent-builder logs to stdout alone.
